For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Mithlesh Kumar Khare, AAP  For the informant : Mr. Awadhesh Kumar, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 5 22-05-2023 Heard Mr. Ansul, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. Awadhesh Kumar who represent the informant as also the State.

The petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Ahiyapur P.S. Case No. 537 of 2022 instituted under Sections 467, 468, 420, 406, 506, 120 (B) / 34 of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 22.06.2022 by the informant Radha Mohan Singh.

As per the prosecution story, an agreement to sale of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64231 of 2022(5) dt.22-05-2023 land bearing Khata no.15 Khesra no. 275 area 1 katha 10 dhurs was finalized at the rate of Rs. 14,10,000/- per katha between him and the petitioners through one Babloo Singh.
After finalization of same, he paid cash Rs. 6,00,000/- each twice in presence of Babloo Singh.
Besides the above, Rs. 11,00,000/- was paid through cheques bearing cheque no. 074960 and 074961 in the account of petitioner no.1.
Later both the petitioners turned their eyes away on the point of execution of sale deed in his favour.

It has also been alleged that when he asked them to Smt Renu Verma @ Renu Verma @ Renu Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186764825/
1 return his money back, the accused persons gave threat of killing.

sentences.text: At the outset learned counsel for the petitioners submit that he is providing the draft of Rs.11 lacs to the informant through Bank Draft Nos. 594288,594289 & 594287 issued by Punjab and Sind Bank.
Mr. Awadhesh Kumar, learned counsel for the informant has gone through the three drafts and/is satisfied that the same are genuine.
A photocopy of the drafts showing receipts of learned counsel for the informant has been provided and is kept on record.
In view of the fair stand taken by both the sides, this Court is inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to Patna High Court CR.
